title: Cycling Elevation and Distance Rollup
dataSources: Strava API activities (`strava:activity`), Garmin Connect (`garmin:activity`), Fitbit Web API (`fitbit:activity`), Peloton workout history (`peloton:workout`).
app: Strava / Garmin Connect / Fitbit / Peloton / Zwift APIs and webhooks via Splunk HEC scripted inputs; GPX/FIT/CSV activity exports ingested as file inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=strava:activity type=Ride
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats sum(distance_km) as km, sum(elevation_m) as climb_m, count as rides by _time
| sort - _time
description: Rolls up your monthly cycling distance, total climbing, and ride count so you can track your season at a glance.
value: A monthly rollup is the perfect scrapbook metric — it captures the shape of your riding season without you logging anything by hand.
implementation: Ingest Strava rides; schedule monthly and keep the rollup as a personal season log.
visualization: Table and column chart of monthly distance and elevation.
grandmaExplanation: It adds up how far and how much you climbed on your bike each month, like a scrapbook of your cycling year.
